title: Dynamics randomization (randomize_dynamics)
desc: Each episode re-rolls physics before the robot moves, for every body with a joint — cubes, cup, all 8 robot links, and 128 invisible grasp-planner helper bodies. Mass: one ±20% factor per body. Inertia: ±20% per body per axis. Friction: every geom of an object is set to the object's AVERAGE authored sliding friction ±20% — this used to quietly strip the fingertip pads of their extra grip (authored μ=2.0 vs 1.0 elsewhere), so the pads were re-authored to μ=1.0 on 2026-07-26 after a grip test showed no slip difference (2/2 cubes in cup either way). The chart shows authored value vs the range actually sampled. Off by default for PiPER-X cubes-in-cup — flipped on here.
metrics: 200 rolls · 4 cubes + cup + 8 robot links + 128 helpers · pooled ratio ranges: mass [0.800, 1.200] · inertia [0.800, 1.200] · friction [0.800, 1.200] (gripper pads: authored 1.0 → sampled [0.80, 1.20])
